title: What It Actually Looks Like to Carry a Phone and Not Be Owned by It
caption:
A godly man still carries a phone.

He's just decided it doesn't get to run him.

Whoever gets your first ten minutes owns your morning. For most guys, that's a notification, not God. Move the phone to another room overnight. Let your first move be toward a Bible, not a screen.

Not every room needs it. Dinner doesn't. A conversation with your brother doesn't. A buzzing phone on the table says the guy across from you is the backup plan.

Check your screen time on Sunday, not to feel bad, but to be honest about what actually ran your week.

You don't need a detox. You need a war you're actually fighting.
